headline: Touchstone Partners advises Membrane Group on equity fundraise from Kurita Water Industries
sum: Membrane Group India Private Limited has raised funds from Kurita Water Industries Limited, a Japan based listed company. Touchstone Partners advised Membrane Group on this fundraise.
detail: Membrane Group India Private Limited has raised funds from Kurita Water Industries Limited, a Japan based listed company. Touchstone Partners advised Membrane Group on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Uday Walia (Partner) and Mahak Goyal (Associate). Also Read Touchstone Partners advises Membrane Group on joint venture with Kurita Water Industries
